title: Herd QA always on
summary: Local Herd always shows Developer sign-in and the QA role switcher by default when APP_ENV is local. Production and Cloudron stay hard-off.
changes: When APP_ENV=local and QA_LOGIN_ENABLED is unset or empty, Developer sign-in and the QA pill turn on automatically; explicit false or 0 still disables them locally.
composer setup / herd-setup.ps1 upserts QA_LOGIN_ENABLED=true on every run, always seeds LocalQaSeeder after migrate (even without demo data), and clears a stale config cache when present.
QaLoginTest, .env.example, docs/herd.md and AGENTS.md document the local default and the production refuse.
version_rationale: Patch: restores expected local Herd behaviour without changing production defaults or the Cloudron refuse.
validation: QaLoginTest (36 tests) green locally, including local unset on, local explicit false off, and non-local still off.
Herd preview on BambiesSumsung: Developer sign-in panel on /login and QA pill after sign-in.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release tag. No database schema changes.
provenance: Milestone epic #849 and pull request #853 on the milestone/v0-66-1-herd-qa-always branch.
